metadata.description: All responses, planning, and implementation documentation must be in Brazilian Portuguese
metadata.context: Immutable language requirement for all PostSpark communications

metadata.description: Post rendered in Workbench must be 100% identical to post generated and approved in HoloDeck
metadata.context: Requires deep clone, strict Zod typing, immutable reference - any discrepancy is critical bug

metadata.description: No zombie elements - every UI component must have clear functional purpose and connected logic
metadata.context: If element exists visually, interactivity must be implemented. Dead UI must be questioned proactively

metadata.description: Canvas restrictions should not dictate creative choices - users should be free to experiment with layouts
metadata.context: Arbitrary drag-and-drop blocks discouraged, safe undo/revert systems required

metadata.description: Zero tolerance for small visual bugs - high-ticket product for enterprise agencies requires meticulous validation
metadata.context: Stability and responsiveness over rushed delivery, regression testing required

metadata.description: All new interactive UI must predict touch usage - 44x44px minimum targets, sheet modals, scroll conflict prevention
metadata.context: Non-negotiable touch optimization for mobile experience

metadata.description: No magic CSS or inline fixed styles - all visual components must consume Tailwind design system
metadata.context: Inline styles only for dynamic calculations (X, Y drag positions)

metadata.description: Exhaust native CSS/Tailwind/React options before adding third-party UI dependencies
metadata.context: Heavy functionality delegated to Backend/Worker on Railway, keep frontend reactive
